narrative.intro: OptumServe Health Services has $1.9B in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Obligations fell 26.2% year over year. The company has 10 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $187M. The Department of Veterans Affairs is by far the largest buyer, accounting for $1.8B of obligations. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the largest market, also with $1.8B in obligations. Other federal buyers include the Department of Health and Human Services with $11.5M and the Department of Defense with $11M. Historical context shows variability: obligations were $756M in FY21, $874M in FY22, $711M in FY23, $1.6B in FY24, and $2.5B in FY25. The FY2026 picture is partial because totals are fiscal year to date. Use these figures to assess agency concentration, market focus, and award concentration when planning capture or compliance work with OptumServe Health Services.

sections.heading: Who are the top buyers in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $1.8B. The Department of Health and Human Services obligated $11.5M, and the Department of Defense obligated $11M. Those three agencies account for the bulk of FY2026 obligations for OptumServe Health Services.

sections.heading: What markets does OptumServe sell into in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the largest market with $1.8B in obligations. Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists account for $11M, All Other Outpatient Care Centers account for $10.8M, and All Other Miscellaneous Ambulatory Health Care Services account for $719K. The market mix shows heavy concentration in physician office services.

faq.q: How much does OptumServe Health Services make from federal contracts?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services has $1.9B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company has 10 awards this fiscal year, an average award size of $187M, and obligations fell 26.2% year over year. Historical annual obligations were $756M in FY21, $874M in FY22, $711M in FY23, $1.6B in FY24, and $2.5B in FY25.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from OptumServe Health Services?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs buys most from OptumServe Health Services, with $1.8B in obligations. The Department of Health and Human Services obligated $11.5M, and the Department of Defense obligated $11M in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does OptumServe Health Services sell to the government?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services sells primarily physician-office services to the government. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) account for $1.8B in obligations, Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists account for $11M, All Other Outpatient Care Centers account for $10.8M, and All Other Miscellaneous Ambulatory Health Care Services account for $719K.

faq.q: Which OptumServe Health Services contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: No expiring-contracts data are listed for FY2026 to date. The available FACTS include current obligations, award counts, average award size, agency buyers, markets, and historical annual obligations but do not include an expiring-contracts table.
